    private $index = 0;

    public function __construct() {
        $this->buffer = explode(' ', trim(fgets(STDIN)));
    }

    public function next(): ?string {

            $line = fgets(STDIN);

            $this->buffer = explode(' ', trim($line));
            $this->index = 0;
        }

<?php
class FastReader {
    private $buffer;
    private $tokens;
    private $tokenIndex;

    public function __construct() {
        $this->buffer = fopen('php://stdin', 'r');
        $this->tokens = [];
        $this->tokenIndex = 0;
    }

    private function readLine(): string {
        return fgets($this->buffer);
    }

    public function next(): string {
        while ($this->tokenIndex >= count($this->tokens)) {
            $line = $this->readLine();
            if ($line === false) {
                return '';
            }
            $this->tokens = preg_split('/\s+/', trim($line), -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY);
            $this->tokenIndex = 0;
        }
        return $this->tokens[$this->tokenIndex++];
    }

    public function nextInt(): int {
        return (int)$this->next();
    }

    public function nextLong(): int {
        return (int)$this->next();
    }

    public function nextDouble(): float {
        return (float)$this->next();
    }
}

<?php
class FastReader {
    private $buffer;
    private $tokens = [];

    public function __construct() {
        $this->buffer = fopen('php://stdin', 'r');
    }

    private function readLine(): string {
        $line = fgets($this->buffer);
        return $line !== false ? $line : '';
    }

    public function next(): string {
        while (empty($this->tokens)) {
            $line = $this->readLine();
            if ($line === '') {
                break;
            }
            $this->tokens = array_reverse(explode(' ', trim($line)));
        }
        return array_pop($this->tokens);
    }

    public function nextInt(): int {
        return (int)$this->next();
    }

    public function nextLong(): int {
        return (int)$this->next();
    }

    public function nextDouble(): float {
        return (float)$this->next();
    }

    public function nextLine(): string {
        $line = fgets($this->buffer);
        return $line !== false ? rtrim($line, "\r\n") : '';
    }

    public function readIntArray(int $n): array {
        $a = [];
        for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
            $a[] = $this->nextInt();
        }
        return $a;
    }

        $a = [];

            $a[] = $this->nextDouble();
        }
        return $a;
    }
}

Imp rapidly proposed a guess that they are the remainders of division of a number n by all integers i from 1 to k. Unfortunately, there are too many integers to analyze for Imp.Imp wants you to check whether all these remainders are distinct. Formally, he wants to check, if all , 1 ≤ i ≤ k, are distinct, i. e. there is no such pair (i, j) that:   1 ≤ i < j ≤ k,  , where  is the remainder of division x by y.
source_data.prob_desc_output_spec: Print "Yes", if all the remainders are distinct, and "No" otherwise. You can print each letter in arbitrary case (lower or upper).
source_data.prob_desc_input_spec: The only line contains two integers n, k (1 ≤ n, k ≤ 1018).
source_data.prob_desc_notes: NoteIn the first sample remainders modulo 1 and 4 coincide.
